Definition: Sheba, the name of a place in Palestine, and of two Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Sheba = "seven"; n pr m; 1) Benjamite, son of Bichri and one who led a rebellion against David; 2) Gadite, brother of Michael, Meshullam, Jorai, Jachan, Zia, and Heber; n pr loc; 3) a town in Simeon
